findings.title: Browser back with a dialog or menu open goes to the previous page
findings.body: With the product detail dialog open, back went to the previous page (About Us) instead of closing the dialog. With the left menu open, back went to the previous page with the menu still open, and the language menu also went to the previous page. On a phone, pressing back to close a dialog loses the screen the user was on. Confirmed (all three cases reproduced with agent-browser back).

findings.title: At phone width the search field is 4px wide, so typed text is not visible
findings.body: At 390px width, tapping the search icon opens the field 4 CSS px wide. After typing "apple" the field was still 4px wide and the text was not visible. Pressing Enter does run the search (3 results). Confirmed (measured with getBoundingClientRect).

findings.title: The Close button on the product detail dialog is cut off below the dialog and not visible
findings.body: The detail dialog ends at y 1395px and the Close button is at y 1472–1552px. The Close button is not visible in the capture. Coordinates are in the 780×1688 screenshot. Whether the button appears when scrolling inside the dialog was not checked.

findings.title: Basket delete runs at once with no confirmation or undo
findings.body: The trash button calls delete(id) directly, with no confirmation dialog or undo notice (purchase-basket.component.ts:137, purchase-basket.component.html:51). Low, because the item can be added again. The −, + and trash buttons are icons only, with empty accessible names (same cause as in the accessibility report a11ysweep-report-en). Confirmed (source checked, not tapped).

findings.title: The two welcome dialog buttons are icons only, and the tutorial button is named "school"
findings.body: The two buttons on the welcome dialog have no text. The accessible name of the left graduation cap button is "school", the icon glyph name, so it does not say that it opens the tutorial; the right eye-off icon closes the dialog. Confirmed (accessible names collected, both buttons tapped).

findings.title: Small tap targets: the tutorial × and the text links on the login screen
findings.body: This map's small-target threshold is 24 CSS px (WCAG 2.5.8, meta.small_target). The tutorial close × is 23×23 CSS px; on the login screen "Forgot your password?" is 12 CSS px high and "Not yet a customer?" is 14 CSS px; on sign-up "Already a customer?" is 14 CSS px. All are below the threshold. The only way to sign-up is this link on the login screen. Confirmed (measured).
